q: Who is eligible to sit BEE's energy manager and energy auditor exams?
title: BEE energy manager exam eligibility
short: A graduate engineer with three years of energy-related work qualifies for both exams, as does a post-graduate engineer, or an engineer with a management post-graduate degree, with two years. Diploma engineers with six years and physics, electronics or chemistry post-graduates with three years qualify only for the manager exam.

ul: Graduate engineer (BE or BTech) with three years of work involving energy use.
Post-graduate engineer (ME or MTech) with two years.
Graduate engineer with a management post-graduate degree, two years.
Post-graduate in physics, electronics or chemistry, with physics and maths at graduation, three years.
Graduate engineer with a management post-graduate degree, two years.

p: Experience must involve energy use in operation, maintenance or planning and be complete by the application closing date. BEE registers candidates only on receipt of an experience certificate.
BEE has required certified managers and auditors to attend a refresher course to retain certification; check the refresher course site for the current deadline.
